records.jp: 詩ちゃん！
はっ、はい……！
詩ちゃんの心のモヤモヤ……<CR>それは、きっと大切な想いのはずだよ！
records.en_original: That feeling in your chest. I know that it's something very important to you!
records.en: That feeling in your chest. I know that it's something very important to you!

records.jp: 詩ちゃんはずっと、人の心が分からなくて悩んできた。<CR>自分は壊れてるって、そう思って生きてきた
records.en_original: The fact you couldn't understand people always bothered you. You thought that you may be broken.
records.en: The fact you couldn't understand people always bothered you. You thought that you may be broken.

records.jp: だよね？
……はい
でも、今は違う
records.en_original: But it's not like that now.
records.en: But it's not like that now.

records.jp: みんなと交流して、一緒にこの世界で過ごして……<CR>時間はかかったけど、少しずつ分かってきたんだよ
records.en_original: It's taken time, but after spending time with all of us here, you've begun to understand.
records.en: It's taken time, but after spending time with all of us here, you've begun to understand.

records.jp: おばあちゃんは、詩ちゃんのことをずっと想ってた。<CR>今の詩ちゃんなら、きっと分かるはずだよ……
records.en_original: Your grandmother loved you. I know you can see that now.
records.en: Your grandmother loved you. I know you can see that now.

records.jp: 私、は……
う、詩ちゃん！
違うでしょう？
私は、祖母のことなんて何とも思っていない
records.en_original: You don't care about your grandmother.
records.en: You don't care about your grandmother.

records.jp: 思い出しなさい？　あの時の痛みを
痛みだけが私を生かしてくれる！<CR>感情なんてものは私には必要ない！！
records.en_original: The pain is all you need! You don't need the crutch that is emotion!
records.en: The pain is all you need! You don't need the crutch that is emotion!

records.jp: ぁ……ぐ……っ
詩ちゃん！
大丈夫っ！　自分を強く持って！！
陽桜莉、さん……っ
フラグメント……！！
私は…………っ
フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.

records.jp: ――私は、寂しかったんですね
そして、あなたもそう
…………何を馬鹿なことを言ってるの？
records.en_original: What nonsense are you on about?
records.en: What nonsense are you on about?

records.jp: 誰にも理解されない。<CR>誰にも受け入れられない
records.en_original: No one understands you. No one accepts you.
records.en: No one understands you. No one accepts you.

records.jp: それが寂しかったんです
ふ、ふざけないで！
これが、人の感情なんでしょうか
records.en_original: Is this what human emotion is?
records.en: Is this what human emotion is?

records.jp: 違う！！
やめろ……私を、理解するな……ッ！！
records.en_original: Don't... Stop trying to understand me...!!
records.en: Don't... Stop trying to understand me...!!

records.jp: 無駄ですよ
私はあなただし、<CR>あなたは私なんですから――
records.en_original: After all, I'm you. And you're me...
records.en: After all, I'm you. And you're me...

records.jp: 詩ちゃんっ！！
……納得がいかない。<CR>あなたにも、自分自身にも
records.en_original: It's not enough. For either of us.
records.en: It's not enough. For either of us.

records.jp: 詩ちゃん…………？
私は許しを乞える立場じゃない。<CR>それなのに、あなたは――
records.en_original: I'm in no position to ask for forgiveness, and yet you still...
records.en: I'm in no position to ask for forgiveness, and yet you still...

records.jp: っ！！<CR>どうしてそんな酷いことばかりするの……っ！？
records.en_original: Why do you do all of these terrible things!
records.en: Why do you do all of these terrible things!

records.jp: ふふっ。そんなの、<CR>楽しいからに決まってるじゃないですか……♪
records.en_original: Hehe. Because it's fun, of course!
records.en: Hehe. Because it's fun, of course!

records.jp: 少女たちのフラグメントを集める私たち。<CR>それを阻もうとする、あなたたち
records.en_original: We were collecting Fragments. You stood in our way.
records.en: We were collecting Fragments. You stood in our way.

records.jp: 私たちは敵対していた
……そうだね
想いなんてすべてまやかしでしかない。<CR>私が信じていたのは痛みだけ
records.en_original: All emotions were nothing but a lie. Pain was the only thing I trusted.
records.en: All emotions were nothing but a lie. Pain was the only thing I trusted.

records.jp: そんなきれいごととまやかしに満ちた世界は、<CR>私にとって苦痛でしかなかった
records.en_original: Such a world filled with lies and deceit was painful for me.
records.en: Such a world filled with lies and deceit was painful for me.

records.jp: だから、すべて壊そうとした
records.en_original: That's why I tried to destroy it all.
records.en: That's why I tried to destroy it all.

records.jp: 想いなんていらない。フラグメントさえ奪えば、<CR>私の考える理想の世界に近づく――
records.en_original: I didn't need emotions. If I could only steal the Fragments, it would bring me closer to my ideal world...
records.en: I didn't need emotions. If I could only steal the Fragments, it would bring me closer to my ideal world...

records.jp: 私は、そう考えていた
根本的に、私たちは相容れない。<CR>あなたたちだって、そうやって私を憎んでいたはず
records.en_original: We were fundamentally incompatible. I'm sure you must have hated me.
records.en: We were fundamentally incompatible. I'm sure you must have hated me.

records.jp: ……違う？
……うん
その顔をやめて……ッ！！
records.en_original: Don't look at me like that...!
records.en: Don't look at me like that...!

records.jp: 思い出せば思い出すほど、理解できなくなる……。<CR>あなたが私に優しくする理由なんてない！！
records.en_original: The more I remember, the less I understand... You have no reason to be so kind to me!
records.en: The more I remember, the less I understand... You have no reason to be so kind to me!

records.jp: なのに、なんで…………っ
……そんなの、決まってるよ
詩ちゃんとおばあちゃんの思い出を見て分かった。<CR>詩ちゃんも苦しんでたんだって<CR>
records.en_original: We all saw in your memories of your grandmother. You've suffered too.
records.en: We all saw in your memories of your grandmother. You've suffered too.

records.jp: やめて！　同情なんて、私は――
records.en_original: Stop! I don't want your pity!
records.en: Stop! I don't want your pity!

records.jp: 大嫌いだった、はずなのに……
陽桜莉さんっ
大丈夫
帰ろう、詩ちゃん。お姉ちゃんも待ってるよ
records.en_original: Let's go home, Uta. Mio is waiting for us.
records.en: Let's go home, Uta. Mio is waiting for us.
